Account summary: large regional health system building clinician-facing search across clinical documentation (progress notes, discharge summaries, imaging reports). Primary ask: high-accuracy RAG with strict PHI controls and full per-request audit.

Data/scale specifics: ~60M historical notes (~8-12 TB uncompressed text), ingest velocity ~200k new notes/day. Typical query shape: clinician search + patient id filter -> expected 100 qps peak for 1 team, 500 qps for org-wide. Latency target: 95th <250ms for retrieval+rerank in interactive flows; background batch indexing can be async. Cost sensitivity: needs cost-per-query model for forecasting at 500 qps sustained.

Tech preferences: prefer embeddings + ANN (HNSW) for recall, then cross-encoder rerank for top-50; open-source embedding models preferred (quantized 8-bit) to avoid CPU/GPU spend, but willing to evaluate Redwood-verified encoder/embedding options. Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput or Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) due to PHI.

Security/compliance: BAA mandatory; SSO/SAML + SCIM; per-token audit logs, KMS-backed key management, retention controls (30/90/365 days options). Data residency: primary in us-east-1. Must support firewall whitelisting / VPC peering; air-gapped option considered for highest-risk datasets.

POC notes: Devon ran a 5M-note index test. Retrieval: avg ANN recall@100 = 0.88 (good). Reranker: CPU cross-encoder latency ~420ms p95 -> plan to test GPU-backed rerank or hybrid approach (hybrid: ANN top-200 then distilled ranker). Need Redwood Optimize recommendations on batching, quantization, and prefix/KV caching to hit 250ms p95.

Stakeholders: CIO (privacy), CDO (data), Head of Clinical IT, Prod Manager for Search (internal champion). Quote from CDO: "We need clinician-grade answers and an ironclad audit trail — no compromises on PHI control."
